DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http:/hwww.dilg.com.ph 14 NOV ?019 c;LG OPINION NO. HON. ARCHIEBALD S. BASILIO Sanggunian Bayan Member Municipality of San Simon, Province of Pampanga Dear Hon. Basilio: s. 202 This has reference to your letter dated 30 July 2019 requesting for legal opinion on whether or not a reformation center constructed with the use of a Performance Challenge Fund may be converted into a legislative building. We opine in the negative. This Department's Memorandum Circular No. 2016-167 (MC 2016-167), dated 23 November 2016, provides for the Operational Guidelines on the Implementation of 2016 Performance Challenge Fund (PFC). Item 5.1.2.2 thereof states: 5.1.2.2 Considering the incentive/subsidy is a top-up to the local development funds of LGUs. Identification of projects should be governed by the policies governing the use of the 20% of the Internal Revenue Allotment (IRA) for local development projects provided for in DBM-DILG Memorandum Circular 2011-1 dated April 13, 2011 amending DILG-DBM JMC No. I, dated September 20, 2005, entitled, "Guidelines on the Appropriation and Utilization of the 200/0 of the Annual IRA for Development Projects" and DILG Memorandum Circular ND. 2010-138 dated December 2, 2010, entitled "Use of the 200/0 Component of the Annual IRA Shares, " hence, PCF subsidy shall not be utilized for the following: • xxx; • Construction, repair or refinishing of administrative offices; xxx The PCF subsidy is mainly to be utilized for the attainment of development goals which the government commits to accomplish. The Reformation Center constructed using the PCF was not for administrative purpose of housing the legislative officials of the municipal government but to be utilized for the rehabilitation of drug users and dependents, which purpose is included in the Millennium Development Goals/Sustainable Development Goals.

The proposal to make the Reformation Center an office of the local sanggunian members contravenes the guidelines of PCF. We recommend that this Department's MC 2016-167 be complied. Thank you. LLLS/42 Very truly yours, By the authority of the Secretary MARIVEL SACENDONCILLO, CESO 111 Undersecretary
